chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hassan (peace be upon him), 'How many can I participate in my Hajj?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'As many as you like to'.
ai.seo_question: How many people can be included in one person's Hajj?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) confirms the permissibility of sharing the reward of a single Hajj among multiple individuals, such as relatives or brethren, without a fixed numerical limit. This ruling highlights the flexibility in Shia jurisprudence regarding *Hajj al-Tatawwu'* (voluntary Hajj) and *Hajj al-Istibdal* (substitution), emphasizing that the spiritual merit can be distributed according to the donor's intent. It serves as a foundational text for the practice of pooling resources for Hajj or gifting the reward of one's pilgrimage to deceased or living relatives.
